text:
Sam W: Heads up — planning a frontend deploy today at 11:30 PST (~10m from now). Canary 10% for 15m, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. Tag: `frontend/v3.2.1`. Need CDN invalidation after canary and a quick smoke run. :rocket:
Maria L: I can own the CDN purge and smoke checks. Will be on-call during window. What exact assets to purge?
Sam W: Only the hashed assets under `/static/fe/v3.2.1/*`. No HTML purge required unless we see page mismatch.
Alex P: Quick FYI — there's a tiny css fallback change; if you see nav shift on canary users, that's expected and should be minor. Ping me if worse.
Joni F: I'll watch client error tracking and run the smoke script. Smoke steps: 1) load homepage, 2) login, 3) open dashboard, 4) run a sample query. I have the script ready: `scripts/smoke.sh`.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Sam W for 1782501123. Canary target=10%. ETA 11:30 PST.
Sam W: Maria — CDN purge command below. Use the `--paths` list, include only the v3.2.1 manifest + chunk folder.
Maria L: Got it. Running purge in 3..2..1
Maria L: ```bash
# Cloudflare API purge
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/purge_cache" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"files":["/static/fe/v3.2.1/manifest.json","/static/fe/v3.2.1/chunks/*"]}'
```
deploy-bot: Canary started for frontend/v3.2.1 — 10% of traffic routed to canary pool.
Joni F: Canary smoke run: homepage ✅, login ✅, dashboard loads (console shows one minor css shift) — no JS errors in Sentry.
Alex P: Thanks. I see one console warning about deprecated prop but not a blocker.
Sam W: Maria — proceed with full purge once canary stabilizes (wait ~15m). If everything good, we do rollout to 100%.
Maria L: Full purge done. Purged manifest + chunks. Cache TTLs should repopulate shortly. :thumbsup:
Joni F: Post-rollout smoke: all checks green. Load test for a minute at 200 rps looks fine. No error spikes.
Sam W: Rollout to 100% now. If anyone sees a spike or major regression, we rollback to `frontend/v3.2.0`.
Alex P: Noted. I’m standing by to approve rollback if needed.
Maria L: Observability note — dashboards updated with the new asset tag, latency panels look normal.
Sam W: Great work, everyone. Follow-up action: create a tiny postmortem if any users report layout regressions; otherwise we call this successful. :tada:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed for frontend/v3.2.1 at 1782501680.
Joni F: Leaving a short comment in the release ticket with smoke screenshots and Sentry link.
Maria L: Thanks all — leaving channel.
Sam W: Thanks :raised_hands:
